newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.30 cent higher.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.30 cent higher.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.30 cent firmer Friday, based on market orders at 1017 EDT, dealers said.
They expect shortcovering by the funds.
"We are getting up to the levels where the funds are going to start covering," a trader said.
Open interest in July stood at 38,090 lots as of early Wednesday.
Thursday, July ended 0.86 cent higher at 73.16 cents a lb after trading from 73.20 to 72.60 cents. New-crop December finished 0.55 cent higher at 75.16 cents.
